capabilities: Run a login shell in a pane that lives in Obsidian's tabs and splits
Launch Claude Code sessions already pointed at the vault folder
Keep the command palette reachable while the terminal captures the keyboard
Reopen the terminal in the same folder after a reload
Rename terminal panes from their tab
extras: The README leads with a security disclosure: the terminal runs programs on your machine with your permissions and can reach files outside the vault. It makes no network connections of its own. Desktop only, macOS and Linux; no Windows terminal pane in this version.
problem: Work in the vault often needs a command run against the vault folder, and switching to a separate terminal app means finding the right window and typing the right cd every time.

relations.evidence: a one-command start for Claude Code already pointed at your vault
INKLINE skins it, and it stays legible on any other theme

summary: Terminal pane plugin that runs your login shell in an Obsidian tab or split, starting in the vault folder, with a one-command Claude Code launcher.
